help.title: Shortcuts at your fingertips
help.footer: Mouse wheel: zoom at the cursor. Drag: pan the board. Click: select a component or pin.
help.diagnosticHint: Describes a file that does not open, without its content.
recents.title: Recent boards
recents.empty: No file has been opened yet.
info.title: Board information
info.footer: Guide lines show net connectivity. They do not replace the geometry of the copper traces in the file.
key.skipHelp: You can skip this step and keep using the app. This encrypted file will remain unopened until a matching key is supplied.
help.shortcutClearSearch: Clear the search field (second press leaves it)
dialogs.keyLabelFz: Paste the 44 hexadecimal 32-bit words of the vendor key (0x optional; spaces, commas or new lines between them).
dialogs.keyLabelXzz: Enter the 16 hexadecimal digits of the key.
dialogs.keyValid: Key format is valid. It is kept for this session only and never saved.
dialogs.keyXzzHexOnly: Only hexadecimal digits (0-9, a-f) are allowed.
dialogs.keyXzzCount: Enter exactly 16 hexadecimal digits ({count} so far).
dialogs.versionWarning: This file declares GENCAD {version}, not 1.4. TRACE parses GENCAD 1.4.
dialogs.versionNotGuaranteed: Reading it as GENCAD 1.4 is not guaranteed to be correct.
dialogs.versionHelp: Some later revisions add records TRACE does not know; the board may be incomplete or wrong.
